name: Al Yamamah Steel Industries Company
summary: Al Yamamah Steel Industries Company manufactures and sells steel products to the construction, electrical, and telecommunication sectors in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Construction, Electricity, and Renewable Energy Sector segments. The company offers hot rolled hallow steel sections, cold rolled hallow steel sections, and steel sheets; space frames; and distribution poles, including octagonal, conical, and special products.
